extrabees.effect.acid.name: Acidic
extrabees.effect.acid.text: Corrodes blocks around the hive: stone and cobblestone turn into gravel, dirt and grass into sand.

extrabees.effect.birthday.name: Birthday
extrabees.effect.birthday.text: Celebrates the birthdays of the Extra Bees team. Harmless.

extrabees.effect.bonemeal_fruit.name: Ripening
extrabees.effect.bonemeal_fruit.text: Works like bone meal on fruit near the hive.

extrabees.effect.bonemeal_mushroom.name: Mushroom
extrabees.effect.bonemeal_mushroom.text: Works like bone meal on mushrooms near the hive.

extrabees.effect.bonemeal_sapling.name: Growth
extrabees.effect.bonemeal_sapling.text: Works like bone meal on saplings near the hive.

extrabees.effect.ectoplasm.name: Ectoplasm
extrabees.effect.ectoplasm.text: Fills empty space around the hive with sticky Ectoplasm blocks.

extrabees.effect.fireworks.name: Fireworks
extrabees.effect.fireworks.text: Shoots fireworks in the bee's colours. Harmless.

extrabees.effect.gravity.name: Gravity
extrabees.effect.gravity.text: Pulls items, mobs and players near the hive towards it.

extrabees.effect.hunger.name: Hunger
extrabees.effect.hunger.text: Makes players near the hive hungry.

extrabees.effect.lightning.name: Lightning
extrabees.effect.lightning.text: Calls lightning down near the hive. It hurts and can set things on fire.

extrabees.effect.meteor.name: Meteor
extrabees.effect.meteor.text: Rains fireballs around the hive. They set blocks and mobs on fire.

extrabees.effect.power.name: Power
extrabees.effect.power.text: Charges RF machines next to the hive.

extrabees.effect.radioactive.name: Unstable
extrabees.effect.radioactive.text: Radiation: hurts every living thing near the hive, you and your animals included. Doesn't break blocks.

extrabees.effect.slow.name: Slowness
extrabees.effect.slow.text: Gives Weakness to players near the hive (despite the name).

extrabees.effect.spawn_creeper.name: Creepers
extrabees.effect.spawn_creeper.text: Spawns Creepers around the hive. They blow up blocks.

extrabees.effect.teleport.name: Teleport
extrabees.effect.teleport.text: Teleports mobs near the hive to random spots and makes them dizzy.

extrabees.effect.water.name: Water
extrabees.effect.water.text: Fills tanks next to the hive with water.

extrabees.effect.wither.name: Wither
extrabees.effect.wither.text: Gives Wither to players near the hive.

forestry.effectAggressive.name: Aggressive
forestry.effectAggressive.text: Stings every living thing near the hive, you and your animals included.

forestry.effectBeatific.name: Beatific
forestry.effectBeatific.text: Gives Regeneration to players near the hive.

forestry.effectCreeper.name: Creeper
forestry.effectCreeper.text: Hisses and explodes next to players who aren't fully protected. It hurts you but doesn't break blocks.

forestry.effectDrunkard.name: Drunkard
forestry.effectDrunkard.text: Gives Nausea to players near the hive.

forestry.effectExploration.name: Explorer
forestry.effectExploration.text: Gives experience to players near the hive.

forestry.effectFertile.name: Fertile
forestry.effectFertile.text: Makes plants near the hive grow faster.

forestry.effectGlacial.name: Freezing
forestry.effectGlacial.text: Freezes water near the hive into ice (depends on the climate). Can break water setups and farms.

forestry.effectHeroic.name: Heroic
forestry.effectHeroic.text: Hurts hostile mobs near the hive.

forestry.effectIgnition.name: Flammable
forestry.effectIgnition.text: Sets players and mobs near the hive on fire. Blocks don't burn.

forestry.effectMisanthrope.name: Misanthrope
forestry.effectMisanthrope.text: Hurts players near the hive (not mobs).

forestry.effectMycophilic.name: Mycophilic
forestry.effectMycophilic.text: Turns grass and dirt near the hive into mycelium, grows giant mushrooms and turns cows into mooshrooms.

forestry.effectRadioactive.name: Radioactive
forestry.effectRadioactive.text: Hurts everything near the hive and DESTROYS BLOCKS around it (not machines or chests). Only breaks blocks while the mobGriefing game rule is on.

forestry.effectReanimation.name: Reanimation
forestry.effectReanimation.text: Brings dropped items near the hive back to life: bones and arrows become Skeletons, rotten flesh Zombies, blaze rods Blazes.

forestry.effectRepulsion.name: Repulsion
forestry.effectRepulsion.text: Makes hostile mobs near the hive run away from players.

forestry.effectResurrection.name: Resurrection
forestry.effectResurrection.text: Brings dropped items near the hive back to life: gunpowder becomes Creepers, ender pearls Endermen, string and spider eyes Spiders, ghast tears Ghasts, and a Dragon Egg THE ENDER DRAGON.

forestry.effectSnowing.name: Snow
forestry.effectSnowing.text: Covers the ground near the hive with snow layers (not in hot places).

gregtech.effectMachineBoost.name: Machine Booster
gregtech.effectMachineBoost.text: Speeds up working GregTech machines near the hive.

gregtech.effectTreetwister.name: Treetwister
gregtech.effectTreetwister.text: Turns saplings near the hive into other saplings, only in some dimensions.

magicbees.effectAblaze.name: Ablaze
magicbees.effectAblaze.text: Spawns Blazes around the hive. They shoot fireballs and set things on fire.

magicbees.effectBatty.name: Batty
magicbees.effectBatty.text: Spawns bats around the hive. Harmless, but they pile up.

magicbees.effectBovine.name: Bovine
magicbees.effectBovine.text: Spawns cows around the hive. Harmless, but they pile up.

magicbees.effectBrainy.name: Brainy
magicbees.effectBrainy.text: Spawns Brainy Zombies (Thaumcraft) when players come near. They attack you.

magicbees.effectCanine.name: Howling
magicbees.effectCanine.text: Spawns wolves around the hive. They pile up.

magicbees.effectCatty.name: Catty
magicbees.effectCatty.text: Spawns ocelots around the hive. Harmless, but they pile up.

magicbees.effectChicken.name: Plucky
magicbees.effectChicken.text: Spawns chickens around the hive. Harmless, but they pile up.

magicbees.effectCrumbling.name: Crumbling
magicbees.effectCrumbling.text: Crumbles stone blocks around the hive: stone into cobblestone, cobblestone into gravel, stone bricks into cracked ones.

magicbees.effectCurative.name: Cleansing
magicbees.effectCurative.text: Clears potion effects from players near the hive, like drinking milk.

magicbees.effectDigSpeed.name: Mining
magicbees.effectDigSpeed.text: Gives Haste to players near the hive.

magicbees.effectDreaming.name: Dreaming
magicbees.effectDreaming.text: Changes blocks around the hive into Botania blocks (Livingrock, Livingwood).

magicbees.effectGhastly.name: Ghastly
magicbees.effectGhastly.text: Spawns Ghasts around the hive. Their fireballs blow up blocks.

magicbees.effectHorse.name: Neighsayer
magicbees.effectHorse.text: Spawns horses around the hive. Harmless, but they pile up.

magicbees.effectInvisibility.name: Invisibility
magicbees.effectInvisibility.text: Makes players near the hive invisible.

magicbees.effectMoveSpeed.name: Swiftness
magicbees.effectMoveSpeed.text: Gives Speed to players near the hive.

magicbees.effectNodeEmpower.name: Empowering
magicbees.effectNodeEmpower.text: Makes Thaumcraft aura nodes near the hive stronger.

magicbees.effectNodePurifying.name: Purifying
magicbees.effectNodePurifying.text: Turns Thaumcraft aura nodes near the hive into Pure nodes.

magicbees.effectNodeRavening.name: Ravening
magicbees.effectNodeRavening.text: Turns Thaumcraft aura nodes near the hive into Hungry nodes, which EAT blocks around them.

magicbees.effectNodeRepair.name: Magnification
magicbees.effectNodeRepair.text: Heals damaged Thaumcraft aura nodes near the hive.

magicbees.effectNodeTainting.name: Tainting
magicbees.effectNodeTainting.text: Turns Thaumcraft aura nodes near the hive into Tainted nodes, which spread Taint.

magicbees.effectPorcine.name: Porcine
magicbees.effectPorcine.text: Spawns pigs around the hive. Harmless, but they pile up.

magicbees.effectSheep.name: Wooly
magicbees.effectSheep.text: Spawns sheep around the hive. Harmless, but they pile up.

magicbees.effectSlowSpeed.name: Time Warp
magicbees.effectSlowSpeed.text: Gives Slowness to players near the hive.

magicbees.effectTransmuting.name: Transmuting
magicbees.effectTransmuting.text: Changes blocks around the hive to match the biome (dirt, sand, stone and so on).

magicbees.effectVisRecharge.name: Recharging
magicbees.effectVisRecharge.text: Recharges Thaumcraft aura nodes near the hive.

magicbees.effectWispy.name: Wispy
magicbees.effectWispy.text: Spawns Thaumcraft Wisps around the hive. They attack you.

magicbees.effectWithering.name: Withering
magicbees.effectWithering.text: Gives Wither to players near the hive.
